svg.aria-label: Proposed AWS production topology: Route 53, CloudFront, WAF and Certificate Manager at the edge; an Application Load Balancer in a public subnet; ECS Fargate tasks in a private subnet; Aurora PostgreSQL with pgvector, ElastiCache Redis and S3 in a data tier; ECR, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, IAM and S3 web assets on a platform rail; and NAT egress to the five model vendors outside the AWS cloud.
